help: forget what the forge no longer has, and what it never needed after all — local branches whose work the base already holds or whose PR a force-push superseded, remote-tracking refs for branches it has deleted, and a closed-unmerged PR's own leftover server branch — a dry run unless --apply

args.name: --apply
args.help: perform the deletions — without it, the branches and reasons are only reported

git ls-remote --heads origin: reads server branches to find a closed-unmerged PR's leftover
gh api graphql: reads a merged PR's force-push history to recognise a superseded former head
git push origin --delete: WRITES the deletion of a closed-unmerged PR's server branch (--apply only, refused loudly under YOGA_NO_SEND)
